records.EmailTextCode:
#F(weblarge)#bDear Investors,#z
#rThank you for your continual support of Marine MechWorks. It is with a heavy heart that I must report a net loss of 17.23 million Golvent for the third quarter, which falls far short of our initial expectations.
#rAfter careful analysis, the main reasons for the losses are:
#r#b[1] High Labor Costs#z
#rDespite implementing a workforce optimization plan last year, labor costs still accounted for 42% of our total expenditures this quarter, significantly higher than the industry average. Two points of note:
#r1. Skilled workers have an average hourly wage of 456 Golvent, nearly 20% higher than local competitors.
#r2. Overtime costs rose by 15.3% due to strict enforcement of the two-day weekend policy in Nova City regulations.
#r#b[2] Overly Generous Benefits
#rOur benefits packages constitute 18.7% of our total costs, which is high for the shipbuilding sector:
#r1. We offer full health insurance coverage for employees.
#r2. Our work-related injury and accident insurance standards exceed legal requirements.
#r3. Dormitory and cafeteria subsidies consume significant funds.
#rTo be frank, these are deep-seated issues, but there is clearly substantial room for amelioration.
#r#b[3] Declining Competitiveness
#rOur competitive edge is weakening as:
#r1. New shipyards further utilize automated production, achieving 1.5 times our capacity.
#r2. Competitors are capturing a greater market share with lower labor costs.
#r3. Our technological innovations have not kept pace with the industry.
#r To address these issues, management plans to:
#r#b·#z Implement a more flexible employment system to reduce fixed labor costs.
#r#b·#z Adjust employee benefits by linking some to performance.
#r#b·#z Seek cost-effective suppliers in order to lower raw material costs.
#rWe appreciate your understanding that the shipbuilding industry is undergoing cyclical adjustments, and short-term losses are unavoidable. We are confident that with these adjustments, Marine MechWorks will return to profitability.
#r

#F(weblarge)#r昨天后半夜，大概两点多钟，我跟往常一样在监控室里轮岗，盯着各个点的情况。看到物流中心仓库的时候，我发现里面有个影子在动。一开始我以为是眼花了，可仔细一看，竟然是一只羊。对，就是羊，白色的，看着跟普通的羊差不多，但又说不出来的奇怪。
#r我心里觉得不对劲，正准备叫上两个人过去看看，结果一眨眼的功夫，监控画面里的羊就没了。就那么凭空消失了，前后不到一分钟。我把监控录像倒回去反复看了几遍，千真万确，就是有只羊突然消失了，也不知道是藏起来了还是怎么了。
#r这还不算完。羊消失后没多久，大概三点左右，有一批工人就来了。他们进车间的时候，我从监控里看，一个个都面无表情，眼睛发直，跟丢了魂儿似的。他们嘴里念叨着什么“兵器”之类的话，自顾自的在那里生产零件。那场面，说实话，看得我后背发凉。他们不像是在工作，更像是……像是中了邪，或者说魔怔了。
#r您之前特意嘱咐过，不管看到啥奇怪的，都别声张，也别让手下人乱说。我记着您的话，所以就自己一个人盯着，没让其他人知道这事。

#r厂长，我知道我的任务就是执行命令，不该问的别问。活儿我已经办妥了，秘密我也守住了。但我心里实在是不安，我们这么干，会不会出什么事情啊？
#r对了，为了让您看得更明白，我把当时看到羊的那个监控画面截了张图，就附在这信后面。
#r

records.EmailTitle: [Must Read This Time!!!] Monthly Library Report
records.EmailTextCode: #F(weblarge)       Director, I know you never really read the monthly reports, so I haven’t taken them seriously before. But this time the situation is so unusual that I must report it to you.#r       First, the numbers. I know that’s what you care about most. This month our borrowing volume exploded: from 80,000 books last month up to 280,000, a 250% increase! Visitor traffic is even more staggering, jumping from 150,000 to 600,000, a 300% rise. In my twelve years as a librarian, I’ve never seen anything like this.#r       Even stranger is the type of books being borrowed. In the past, people mostly checked out novels, supplementary textbooks, or lifestyle books. Now the most popular titles are: Industrial Development Records of Nova City, Manufacturing Processes for Precision Machinery, Principles of Modern Engineering Design, Advanced Engineering Mathematics: Computational Methods. Especially books related to weapons manufacturing, such as Metalworking and Forming Techniques, Fundamentals of Explosives Physics, Handbook of Ballistics Calculations, and Introduction to Chaos Weapons. These are books that normally wouldn’t be borrowed even a few times in a year, but now people are lining up for them every day.#r       My professional curiosity got the better of me, so I flipped through some of these books. Curator, I found something very strange: although the fields are completely different, each of them mentions something called the “Ultimate Weapon Project” in different chapters. Some only briefly in the history of Nova City, some in technical application examples, some even in the references. I don’t know what this project really is, but it doesn’t feel like anything good.#r       What unsettles me even more is the state of the borrowers. They come in with vacant eyes, like sleepwalkers, grab the books, and leave without a word. Even familiar regulars now act as if they don’t recognize me. Yesterday, a young man borrowed Principles of Explosives Chemistry. I joked, “You’re not planning to make a bomb, are you?” He actually nodded seriously! I was terrified.#r       Curator, I don’t think this is a simple matter. It may need to be reported to higher authorities. This eerie situation is already beyond the library’s capacity to handle. Perhaps you could contact the relevant departments to find out what this “Ultimate Weapon Project” really is? And if nothing else, maybe you could request some extra budget to hire more librarians. The crowds are overwhelming, and I can hardly keep up.
#F(weblarge)<align=center>#bAs the clock tolls,#z#r#bBeneath the sea of books, a skeleton lies in repose.#z#r#bThe flowers bloom in coruscating splendor.#z</align>

records.EmailTextCode: #IHud【独家焦点】赛道惊雷：又一个“白靖”？不，是重塑秩序的全新传奇#z#r#r赛车界的聚光灯下，总不乏横空出世的奇迹。多年前，白靖的骤然出圈曾让整个赛场为之颤抖，他以极其凌厉的驾驶风格和无可匹敌的速度，给所有的老牌车手留下了难以磨灭的震撼。而如今，伴随着轮胎撕裂沥青的尖啸，赛道上再次弥漫起那种令人窒息的统治力。一位横扫赛场的神秘少年正以不可阻挡的姿态闯入大众视野，这种似曾相识的压迫感，让无数资深车迷和评论员惊呼：难道赛车界又迎来了一个白靖？#r#r[图片占位 1：一张极具视觉冲击力的赛场抓拍。画面中是一辆涂装凌厉的新锐赛车，正以一种几乎要突破画面的速度冲出赛道迷雾，背景是被彻底甩在身后的多辆老牌车队赛车，画面边缘辅以强烈的动态模糊以凸显压迫感。]#r#r在过去短短的一年中，这位神秘少年交出了一份堪称神迹的成绩单。从赛季初的寂寂无名，到随后不可思议地包揽了今年所有大奖赛分站赛的冠军，他用近乎绝对理性的过弯轨迹和极其刁钻的超车路线，彻底粉碎了各大老牌车队的战术封锁。他的每一场比赛录像都成为各大俱乐部赛后逐帧分析的教材，却至今无人能破解他那种仿佛与车辆融为一体的恐怖直觉。#r#r[图片占位 2：一张赛车完美贴合弯道内线（Apex）的特写照片。特写镜头聚焦在死死咬住弯道边缘的轮胎上，轮胎与赛道剧烈摩擦产生一丝青烟，直观地展现出少年极其恐怖且精准的车辆控制力。]#r#r在年度最后一场分站赛落幕后，这位备受瞩目的天才少年罕见地接受了媒体的短暂采访。当记者问及他那惊人车技的训练方式时，他表现出了远超同龄人的冷酷：“没有捷径，只是把所有的感官都交给了机械。极限不是开出来的，是每一次无限逼近失控边界时算出来的。”对于这惊艳世界的一年，他的感想显得尤为平淡：“这只是一场热身，赛道上的对手比我想象的要无趣。”而谈到未来的职业目标，少年的眼中终于露出了锋芒：“我听说以前这里有个规矩，有个人不可战胜。我的目标就是打破所有旧的规矩。”#r#r[图片占位 3：神秘少年赛后采访照。他穿着暗色调的赞助商赛车服，单手随性地夹着头盔，眼神深邃且带着一丝不易察觉的桀骜，直视着镜头。]#r#r这位天才少年的崛起，无疑为沉寂已久的赛车界注入了一股狂暴的飓风。人们总是习惯性地将他与那个曾经惊才绝艳的名字联系在一起，但无论从成绩的恐怖稳定性，还是他所展现出的绝对冰冷的比赛气场来看，他的锋芒比之当年横空出世的白靖，可以说是有过之而无不及。时代的引擎已经换代，他并不是来成为“下一个白靖”的。我们有理由相信，这颗冉冉升起的新星，正准备将旧日的丰碑彻底甩在身后，去成就一段属于他自己的、更加不可逾越的新传奇。#r#r[图片占位 4：聚光灯下的最高领奖台远景。少年手举冠军奖杯，只留下一个极具统治力的背影，上方是漫天飘落的金色雨，预示着赛车界新王的登基。]

Although no exhibits were damaged, it exposed vulnerabilities in our patrol and access control procedures.#r#r#r#rII. Rectification Mandates#r#r1. Patrol frequency has been increased from once every two hours to once per hour, with priority coverage focusing on the main entrance and backstage areas.#r#r2. All individuals who are entering and exiting must undergo secondary verification before the gallery opens to ensure all locks and surveillance systems are functioning properly.#r#r3. Leaving your post, using your phone, or sleeping while on duty is strictly prohibited. Any violation will be treated as an unexcused absence.#r#r4. Report any abnormalities immediately without exception. Do not exercise personal judgment and subsequently ignore them.#r#r#r#rIII. Reminder#r#rThe last incident resulted in no losses, but that does not mean we’ll be so lucky next time. The exhibits in this gallery are of extremely high value. We ask that all staff remain vigilant and take every shift with the utmost seriousness.
